apps.name: Aura
apps.subtitle: Your strap, read on your phone.
apps.localizedDescription:
Aura reads the strap you own over Bluetooth and works out sleep, recovery, strain and more on the phone. No account and no cloud.

The IPA is unsigned on purpose: SideStore or AltStore signs it with your own Apple ID. Apple Health needs a paid developer account; with a free one, Aura can send to Apple Health through Shortcuts.

privacy.NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Aura rings your wake alarm on the phone after the strap buzz, and the streak alarm if you turn it on, even on silent.
privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Noop connects directly to your WHOOP strap to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery and sensor data on your iPhone. Sharing occurs only through an export, backup, Apple Health write or Svea provider you explicitly enable.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Aura opens the camera only when you choose to: to scan a food's barcode or label, or to put today's numbers on a photo. Pictures stay on your iPhone unless you share them.
privacy.NSHealthClinicalHealthRecordsShareUsageD: Noop does not read clinical health records. This appears only because the certificate used to sign Noop grants that capability.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Noop reads the Apple Health data types you approve to compute recovery, effort and sleep. They stay local unless you explicitly export, back up or consent to share a category with a configured Svea provider.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Noop writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Noop records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace and a map, including while the screen is off. The route is stored locally unless you export or back up the activity.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Noop uses the microphone only when you ask Svea a question by voice. Audio is transcribed on your iPhone; only the resulting text can be sent to the provider you configured.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Noop reads your iPhone's step count and barometer during a workout, for its steps and the height climbed, and shows them in the activity summary. It stays local unless you export or back up the activity.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Aura saves the share cards you make to your photo library when you tap Save.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Noop transcribes your spoken question on your iPhone so you can ask Svea without typing. Audio is not sent to the configured AI provider.
